messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "The creature is a large, heavily built four-legged animal with the overall shape, shaggy brown fur, head, ears, legs, paws, claws, and short tail of a brown bear, shown in side profile facing right. Growing from its forehead is a single long, curved, glossy dark brown horn that sweeps upward and backward. Covering most of its back from the shoulders to the hips is a large, glossy, dark brown domed shell divided into front and rear sections with fine lengthwise ridges and a segmented rim along the lower edge, resembling a beetle's wing cases.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown bear head with tan muzzle, brown eyes and black nose", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "long curved glossy dark brown rhinoceros beetle horn", "part": "horn", "where": "on the forehead between the eyes curving upward and backward"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head behind the horn"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "underneath the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long light claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "small short furry brown bear tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear end of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown beetle wing cases with fine ridges and a segmented lower rim", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back from behind the shoulders to above the tail, divided into two sections"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
